Part of Makita's 18v LXT cordless range, the DUB185 is a compact and lightweight blower which can also be used as a vacuum cleaner if a suitable dust bag is attached (not included). Designed to offer increased air volume compared to previous models, the DUB185 has three air volume settings and a variable speed trigger for maximum control. This is a bare tool which is supplied without a battery or charger.
